header_sentences: See Sign, for the Mark set on Cain.

contexts.text: The characteristic marks (of parents seen in their children).
After they have often been rejected by Societies, they contract as it were a mark, like Cain, by which they are Known wherever they go. Described. SE 1281. SE 2499.
Thus the robber... bears such a mark that they flee as from a murderer.
A characteristic mark of the evil is that their ideas... are wont to begin from good, but to cease in evil: but of the good that their ideas... can begin from evil but cease in good...
